correctness.rationale: A three-color CDV must be an internal vertex whose two edge increments in Z/3 agree, so q increment-sign changes partition the word into q+1 constant runs. In each run the three CDV-color counts differ by at most one; thus a-c<=q+1 and n-2=a+b+c+q force n>=2a+b+1. On the diagonal n>=3r+2. The explicit periodic or alternating-pair colorings attain 3r+2 (r=s=t), 3r+1 (r=s>t), and 2r+s+1 (r>s); monotone extension in n preserves the CDVs. The 2-color case is the path bipartition. Independent enumeration of all proper 3-colorings for n=2..11 matched every threshold with r<=3; these checks do not replace the all-n proof.
